title: Michael Page Jobs Scraper
description: Collect Michael Page job listings with full descriptions, salary details, sector data, and structured job metadata.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: A Michael Page search URL. When supplied, it takes precedence over the keyword, location, and market fields.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Job search term, for example 'project manager' or 'data analyst'.

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional city, region, or postal code used to narrow the search, for example 'New York'.

domain.title: Country site
domain.description: Michael Page market to search. Each market returns its own local listings.

results_wanted.title: Maximum jobs
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of jobs to save.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Safety cap on the number of search result pages to read.

maxConcurrency.title: Detail concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel job-detail requests. Higher values finish faster with a proxy; lower values are safer without one. Try 12 to 16 for large proxy runs.

includeJobDetails.title: Include job details
includeJobDetails.description: Read each job page for the full description, consultant, and reference. Turn off for a faster listing-only run.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify datacenter proxy is used by default. Clear it to connect directly, or add custom proxy URLs.
